design_decisions.title: windows_multiwindow_observability_and_lifecycle
design_decisions.rationale: Issue #18 shows create/show/first-frame/window-enumeration is not observable enough to distinguish product failure from Win32 test discovery failure.
constraints: Add structured diagnostics at create/show/bootstrap/close boundaries with category, controller/window id, arguments, elapsed time, and exception/stack trace.
Do not log secrets or file contents.
Preserve macOS behavior and existing MultiWindowPlatform test seam.
Test product lifecycle separately from Win32 title/PID enumeration.
Do not change global navigation policy or the 600dp desktop breakpoint.
acceptance: A Windows smoke test proves create returns a controller and the child receives type=category/category arguments.
Three categories become observable with deterministic evidence or the report identifies the exact failing lifecycle boundary.
Reuse and three close/reopen cycles pass.
No Invalid engine handle or Failed to send message to Flutter engine errors.

design_decisions.title: module_local_360dp_layout_repairs
design_decisions.rationale: The three R9 defects are module-local fixed-size/Row assumptions, not an app-shell defect.
constraints: microtask owns its grid/card layout; use LayoutBuilder and compact composition under 600dp.
isolate-basic owns interactiveDemo sizing; remove the fixed-height bottom overflow without changing LearningScaffold globally.
adsorption-line owns toolbar composition; use LayoutBuilder/Wrap or compact rows and keep Slider usable.
Preserve 600dp and 1280dp desktop layouts and interactions.
No blanket Row-to-Column rewrite.
acceptance: microtask 360x860 has zero RenderFlex overflow and all cards remain reachable.
isolate-basic 360x860 has zero RenderFlex overflow and both actions remain reachable.
adsorption-line 360x860 has zero horizontal overflow and tool/color/stroke controls remain reachable.
All three pass 600x860 and 1280x860 regression checks.

design_decisions.title: bounded_windows_test_runner
design_decisions.rationale: The ten-minute monolithic acceptance run obscures the failing case and leaves residual processes.
constraints: Split navigation, responsive, multiwindow, video, and file-picker groups into independently runnable tests.
Use bounded waits with explicit timeout messages; avoid unbounded pumpAndSettle.
Close child windows and cancel timers/subscriptions in tearDown/tearDownAll.
Print START/PASS/FAIL with elapsed_ms for every case.
Kill only test-owned residual flutter_forge.exe/dartvm.exe processes.
acceptance: Each group completes within 30 minutes and reports the last completed case.
The full orchestrated run completes without residual test-owned processes.
Failure in one group does not erase completed evidence from other groups.

design_decisions.title: release_build_diagnosis
design_decisions.rationale: An existing executable does not prove flutter build windows --release exited successfully.
constraints: Start from a clean Windows build directory and capture flutter -v/MSBuild/CMake stage logs.
Use a bounded timeout that records the active process tree and last build stage before termination.
Do not accept a stale pre-existing Release artifact.
CI/release workflow changes are out of scope unless a source fix cannot be verified otherwise and the user approves a packaging task.
acceptance: flutter build windows --release exits 0 on Windows or a precise external/toolchain blocker is recorded.
Artifact mtime is later than build start and required DLLs are present.
A clean launch smoke verifies the built executable.
